name: Eklipse
shortDescription: Finds highlight clips from Twitch, YouTube, and Kick streams and exports them vertical.
longDescription: Eklipse says it connects a Twitch, YouTube, or Kick channel, watches the saved VOD, and returns highlight clips sized for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. The pricing path we opened redirected to the homepage and did not list a monthly price. We did not connect an account.
